title: Motion Platform
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Environment and Target/Motion_Platform.md
text: Motion platform, 3 inputs, 3 outputs, {Model of object motion} sets Object motion model; {Initial position (m)} sets the initial position of platform, {Initial velocity (m/s)} sets the initial velocity of platform, {Source of velocity}, {Velocity (m/s)} sets the current velocity of platform, {Source of acceleration}, {Acceleration (m/s^2)} sets the acceleration of platform, {Custom trajectory waypoints}, {Mechanical scanning mode}, {Initial scan angle (deg)} sets the initial scan angle of platform, {Azimuth scan angle span (deg)} sets the azimuth span, {Azimuth scan rate (deg/s)}, {Initial orientation axes}, {Enable orientation axes output} sets the output orientation axes, {Source of elapsed simulation time}, {Inherit sample rate}, {Sample rate (Hz)} sets the sampling rate and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
